> isomman luolan kokoinen (20×8) ja keskellä kuten napit (`center`), ja

engine.lib/std/adjacency.rlml:
# STD: Vierekkäisyys

> Koottu vakiokirjaston luvuista (RS 4.2). Speksi on normatiivinen,
> joten muutos tehdään ensin speksiin.

namespace STD

```roguescript
event ADJACENT(who: entity, other: entity)

event APART(who: entity, other: entity)

query NEIGHBOURS(who: entity, around: area) -> collection:
    return entities(in: near(around, 1)) where it != who

fn MEET(who: entity, others: collection):
    for e in others:
        emit ADJACENT(who, e)
        emit ADJACENT(e, who)

fn PART(who: entity, others: collection):
    for e in others:
        emit APART(who, e)
        emit APART(e, who)

after enter(who, p, prev) as ADJACENCY_MOVE when prev != none:
    was = NEIGHBOURS(who, prev)
    now = NEIGHBOURS(who, p)
    PART(who, was where not it in now)
    MEET(who, now where not it in was)

after arrive(who, map, p) as ADJACENCY_ARRIVE:
    MEET(who, NEIGHBOURS(who, p))

after depart(who, map, p) as ADJACENCY_DEPART:
    PART(who, NEIGHBOURS(who, p))

after created(e) as ADJACENCY_CREATED:
    MEET(e, NEIGHBOURS(e, e))

after removed(e) as ADJACENCY_REMOVED:
    PART(e, NEIGHBOURS(e, e))
```

engine.lib/std/combat.rlml:
# STD: Taistelu

> Koottu vakiokirjaston luvuista (STD 3, 4, 5, 5.1 ja 8). Speksi on normatiivinen,
> joten muutos tehdään ensin speksiin.

namespace STD

include core.rlml

component HP
- now number
- max number default now

component MELEE
- damage dice

component DROPS
- loot table

component RANGED
- range number
- damage dice
- lob bool default false
- ammo name default none
- projectile name default GLYPH.MISSILE

component MARKSMANSHIP
- value number default 0

component EVASION
- value number default 0

component THROWN
- damage dice

component AMMO
- count number default 1

messages
- MESSAGE.COMBAT.HIT TARGET AMOUNT
- MESSAGE.COMBAT.HURT AMOUNT
- MESSAGE.COMBAT.DIED VICTIM
- MESSAGE.COMBAT.YOU_DIED
- MESSAGE.COMBAT.MISS TARGET

```roguescript
event HIT(target: entity, attacker: entity, amount: number, cause: name = none)

event DIED(victim: entity, killer: entity, cause: name = none)

event MISSED(target: entity, attacker: entity)

fn HURT(target: entity, amount: number, source: entity = none, cause: name = none):
    emit HIT(target, source, amount, cause)

fn STRIKE(attacker: entity, target: entity) -> bool:
    if attacker has no MELEE or target has no HP or not target.at in adjacent(attacker):
        return false
    emit HIT(target, attacker, attacker.MELEE.damage)
    noise(attacker.at, SOUND.FIGHT, source: attacker)
    return true

command ATTACK(target: entity) cost 120:
    return STRIKE(actor, target)

on HIT(target, attacker, amount, cause) as APPLY_DAMAGE:
    if target has no HP:
        return
    target.HP.now -= amount
    if target.HP.now <= 0:
        emit DIED(target, attacker, cause)

after HIT(target, attacker, amount) as HIT_MESSAGE priority -10 when WITNESSED(target):
    if target == player and SOLO():
        log(MESSAGE.COMBAT.HURT, AMOUNT: amount)
    else:
        log(MESSAGE.COMBAT.HIT, TARGET: target, AMOUNT: amount)

on DIED(victim, killer) as DEATH priority -10:
    if victim has DROPS:
        spawn(victim.DROPS.loot, at: victim)
    destroy(victim)

after DIED(victim, killer) as DEATH_MESSAGE priority -10 when WITNESSED(victim):
    if victim == player and SOLO():
        log(MESSAGE.COMBAT.YOU_DIED)
    else:
        log(MESSAGE.COMBAT.DIED, VICTIM: victim)

fn HITS(shooter: entity, target: entity) -> bool:
    attack = 1d20
    if shooter has MARKSMANSHIP:
        attack += shooter.MARKSMANSHIP.value
    save = 1d20
    if target has EVASION:
        save += target.EVASION.value
    return attack > save

query ROUTE(shooter: entity, target: pos, range: number, lob: bool) -> area:
    if lob:
        return ray(shooter.at, target, for: shooter, mode: MISSILE)
    return ray(shooter.at, target, for: shooter, range: range, mode: MISSILE)

fn STRIKE_LINE(shooter: entity, route: area, lob: bool) -> entity:
    candidates = route
    if lob and route.count > 0:
        candidates = route where it == route.last
    for p in candidates:
        victim = (entities(in: p) where it has HP and it != shooter).first
        if victim != none:
            if HITS(shooter, victim):
                return victim
            emit MISSED(victim, shooter)
    return none

query LANDING(shooter: entity, route: area, victim: entity) -> pos:
    if victim != none:
        return victim.at
    if route.count > 0:
        return route.last
    return shooter.at

command SHOOT(target: pos aim actor.RANGED.range at HOSTILES(actor)) cost 120:
    if actor has no RANGED:
        return false
    w = actor.RANGED
    ammo = none
    if w.ammo != none:
        if actor has no PACK:
            return false
        ammo = (actor.PACK.items where it is w.ammo and it has AMMO and it.AMMO.count > 0).first
        if ammo == none:
            return false
    noise(actor.at, SOUND.SHOT, source: actor)
    route = ROUTE(actor, target, w.range, w.lob)
    victim = STRIKE_LINE(actor, route, w.lob)
    land = LANDING(actor, route, victim)
    fly(w.projectile, line(actor.at, land) - actor.at, speed: 30ms)
    if ammo != none:
        ammo.AMMO.count -= 1
        pile = (entities(in: land) where it is w.ammo and it has AMMO).first
        if pile != none:
            pile.AMMO.count += 1
        else:
            spawn(w.ammo, at: land)
        if ammo.AMMO.count <= 0:
            destroy(ammo)
    if victim != none:
        emit HIT(victim, actor, w.damage)

command THROW(item: entity from actor.PACK.items, target: pos aim 6 at HOSTILES(actor)) cost 120:
    route = ROUTE(actor, target, 6, true)
    victim = none
    if item has THROWN:
        victim = STRIKE_LINE(actor, route, true)
    land = LANDING(actor, route, victim)
    fly(item.render.tile, line(actor.at, land) - actor.at, speed: 30ms)
    move(item, to: land)
    if victim != none:
        emit HIT(victim, actor, item.THROWN.damage)

query CAN_SHOOT(shooter: entity, foe: entity) -> bool:
    if shooter has no RANGED or distance(shooter, foe) > shooter.RANGED.range:
        return false
    w = shooter.RANGED
    if w.ammo != none and (shooter has no PACK or (shooter.PACK.items where it is w.ammo and it has AMMO and it.AMMO.count > 0).count == 0):
        return false
    return foe.at in ROUTE(shooter, foe.at, w.range, w.lob)

after MISSED(target, attacker) as MISS_MESSAGE priority -10 when WITNESSED(target):
    log(MESSAGE.COMBAT.MISS, TARGET: target)
```
engine.lib/std/core.rlml:
# STD: Pelaaja ja aloitus

> Koottu vakiokirjaston luvuista (STD 3 ja 8). Speksi on normatiivinen,
> joten muutos tehdään ensin speksiin.

namespace STD

component PLAYER
- class card default DEFAULT.PLAYER

entity DEFAULT.PLAYER
- HP now 10
- MELEE 1d4
- PACK
- blocks move
- ALIGNMENT 0
- FACTION GROUP.PLAYER
- sight radius 8
- hearing
- ai behavior HUNTER
- render GLYPH.PLAYER

```roguescript
query WITNESSED(e: entity) -> bool:
    return seat_of(e) != none or in_view(e)

query SOLO() -> bool:
    return seats().count < 2 and members(seats().first).count < 2

query OPEN(a: area, who: entity) -> area:
    return a where entities(in: it).count == 0 and not blocks(it, move, for: who)

fn SPAWN_MEMBER(n: number, at: area) -> entity:
    if game has PLAYER:
        e = spawn(game.PLAYER.class, at: at).first
    else:
        e = spawn(DEFAULT.PLAYER, at: at)
    if e != none:
        control(e, seat: n)
    return e

on begin() as SPAWN_PLAYER:
    for n in seats():
        if n == seats().first:
            SPAWN_MEMBER(n, game.at)
        else:
            SPAWN_MEMBER(n, OPEN(near(game.at, 0..2), none))

on join(seat) as JOIN_PLAYER:
    if player == none or player.at == none:
        return
    SPAWN_MEMBER(seat, OPEN(near(player, 1..2), none))

fn SWITCH_BY(step: number) -> bool:
    n = seat_of(actor)
    if n == none:
        return false
    group = members(n)
    if group.count < 2:
        return false
    i = 0
    here = 0
    for e in group:
        if e == actor:
            here = i
        i = i + 1
    control(group[(here + step) % group.count])
    return true

command SWITCH() cost 0:
    return SWITCH_BY(1)

command SWITCH.PREV() cost 0:
    return SWITCH_BY(-1)
```
engine.lib/std/exits.rlml:
# STD: Uloskäynnit

> Koottu vakiokirjaston luvuista (STD 3 ja 5). Speksi on normatiivinen,
> joten muutos tehdään ensin speksiin.

namespace STD

include core.rlml
include ai.rlml

component EXIT
- to name
- at label default START
- step bool default false

```roguescript
fn TRAVEL_GROUP(who: entity, door: entity):
    group = players where it.map == who.map
    tag = entities(in: near(door.at, 1)) where it has FOLLOW and seat_of(it) == none and LEADER_OF(it) in group
    for e in group:
        travel(e, door.EXIT.to, at: door.EXIT.at)
    for e in tag:
        travel(e, door.EXIT.to, at: door.EXIT.at)

scene EXIT.LEAVE_OTHERS(who: entity, door: entity):
    say(EXIT.LEAVE_OTHERS.ASK)
    choice:
        YES:
            TRAVEL_GROUP(who, door)
        NO:
            return

fn USE_EXIT(who: entity, exit: entity) -> bool:
    if seat_of(who) == none:
        travel(who, exit.EXIT.to, at: exit.EXIT.at)
        return true
    away = players where it.map == who.map and distance(it, exit) > 1
    if away.count > 0:
        start(EXIT.LEAVE_OTHERS(who, exit))
        return false
    TRAVEL_GROUP(who, exit)
    return true

command TAKE_EXIT() cost 120:
    exit = (entities(in: actor.at) where it has EXIT).first
    if exit == none:
        return false
    return USE_EXIT(actor, exit)

after enter(who, p, prev) as EXIT_STEP when prev != none and seat_of(who) != none:
    exit = (entities(in: p) where it has EXIT and it.EXIT.step).first
    if exit != none:
        USE_EXIT(who, exit)

query EXIT_CELL(who: entity, p: pos) -> bool:
    return (entities(in: p) where it has EXIT and it.EXIT.step).count > 0

on arrive(who, map, p) as GROUP_ARRIVAL when seat_of(who) != none or who has FOLLOW:
    if (entities(in: p) where it != who and blocks(it, move, for: who, tiles: false)).count == 0:
        return
    spot = OPEN(near(p, 1..2), who)
    if spot.count > 0:
        move(who, to: spot)
```
engine.lib/std/gen.rlml:
# STD: Generointi

> Koottu vakiokirjaston luvuista (STD 10). Speksi on normatiivinen,
> joten muutos tehdään ensin speksiin.

namespace STD

```roguescript
fn SCATTER_TILES(t: name, share: percent, area: area = tiles()):
    for p in area:
        if chance(share):
            carve(p, t)

query FLOOR_AROUND(p: pos, floor: name) -> number:
    return ((near(p, 1) - p) and at(floor)).count

fn SMOOTH(floor: name, wall: name, area: area = tiles()):
    cells = area and (at(floor) or at(wall))
    grow = cells where FLOOR_AROUND(it, floor) <= 3
    shrink = cells where FLOOR_AROUND(it, floor) >= 5
    carve(grow, wall)
    carve(shrink, floor)

fn ROOMS(count: range, width: range, height: range, area: area = tiles()) -> list area:
    rooms = []
    taken = area - area
    want = choose(count)
    tries = 0
    while rooms.count < want:
        tries += 1
        if tries > want * 20:
            break
        room = rect(area.choose(), choose(width), choose(height))
        if (room - area).count == 0 and (near(room, 1) and taken).count == 0:
            rooms += room
            taken = taken or room
    return rooms

fn CONNECT(floor: name, with: name = floor):
    cells = at(floor)
    if cells.count == 0:
        return
    joined = region(cells.first, of: at(floor) or at(with))
    for p in cells:
        if not p in joined:
            goal = nearest(joined, p)
            bend = pos(goal.x, p.y)
            carve(line(p, bend) or line(bend, goal), with)
            joined = region(goal, of: at(floor) or at(with))

query FITS(p: name, spot: pos, area: area) -> bool:
    shape = footprint(p, at: spot)
    if shape == none:
        return false
    return (shape - area).count == 0

fn PLACE(p: name, area: area = tiles()) -> area:
    spots = area where FITS(p, it, area)
    if spots.count == 0:
        return none
    spot = spots.choose()
    stamp(p, at: spot)
    return footprint(p, at: spot)
```

# STD: Esineet

> Koottu vakiokirjaston luvuista (STD 3, 4 ja 5). Speksi on normatiivinen,
> joten muutos tehdään ensin speksiin.

namespace STD

component PACK
- items collection

component ITEM

messages
- MESSAGE.LOOT.PICKUP ITEM
- MESSAGE.LOOT.DROP ITEM
- MESSAGE.LOOT.ALLY_PICKUP WHO ITEM
- MESSAGE.LOOT.ALLY_DROP WHO ITEM

```roguescript
event PICKED_UP(who: entity, item: entity)

event DROPPED(who: entity, item: entity)

fn GIVE(to: entity, card: card):
    spawn(card, into: to.PACK.items)

command PICK_UP(item: entity from entities(in: actor.at) where it has ITEM) cost 120:
    if actor has no PACK:
        return false
    if item has AMMO:
        same = (actor.PACK.items where it is item and it has AMMO).first
        if same != none:
            same.AMMO.count += item.AMMO.count
            destroy(item)
            emit PICKED_UP(actor, same)
            return
    move(item, to: actor.PACK.items)
    emit PICKED_UP(actor, item)

command DROP(item: entity from actor.PACK.items) cost 120:
    move(item, to: actor.at)
    emit DROPPED(actor, item)

after PICKED_UP(who, item) as PICKUP_MESSAGE priority -10 when seat_of(who) != none:
    if who == player and SOLO():
        log(MESSAGE.LOOT.PICKUP, ITEM: item)
    else:
        log(MESSAGE.LOOT.ALLY_PICKUP, WHO: who, ITEM: item)

after DROPPED(who, item) as DROP_MESSAGE priority -10 when seat_of(who) != none:
    if who == player and SOLO():
        log(MESSAGE.LOOT.DROP, ITEM: item)
    else:
        log(MESSAGE.LOOT.ALLY_DROP, WHO: who, ITEM: item)
```
engine.lib/std/move.rlml:
# STD: Liike

> Koottu vakiokirjaston luvuista (STD 3 ja 5). Speksi on normatiivinen,
> joten muutos tehdään ensin speksiin.

namespace STD

include relations.rlml
include combat.rlml
include sound.rlml

component SNEAKING

component FOOD
- points number default 30
- group bool default false

```roguescript
event BUMP(who: entity, other: entity)

query STEP_SOUND(e: entity) -> name:
    if e has SNEAKING:
        return SOUND.SNEAK
    return SOUND.STEP

query CAN_STEP(who: entity, to: pos) -> bool:
    return to in adjacent(who) and not LEASHED(who, to)

query LEASHED(who: entity, to: pos) -> bool:
    return leashed(who, to)

query BLOCKER(who: entity, to: pos) -> entity:
    return (entities(in: to) where it != who and blocks(it, move, tiles: false)).first

fn DO_STEP(who: entity, to: pos):
    move(who, to: to)
    noise(to, STEP_SOUND(who), source: who)

command STEP(to: pos) cost 120:
    if actor has SNEAKING:
        wait 120
    if not CAN_STEP(actor, to):
        return false
    other = BLOCKER(actor, to)
    if other != none:
        emit BUMP(actor, other)
        if other has HP and MAY_ATTACK(actor, other):
            return ATTACK(other)
        if FRIENDS(actor, other) and (other has ai or seat_of(other) != none) and not (controlled(actor) and controlled(other)) and not blocks(actor.at, move, for: other, except: actor):
            move(other, to: actor.at)
            DO_STEP(actor, to)
            return
        return false
    if blocks(to, move, for: actor):
        return false
    DO_STEP(actor, to)

command MOVE(dir: dir) cost 120:
    return STEP(actor.at + dir)

command MOVE.NORTH = MOVE(north)

command MOVE.NORTHEAST = MOVE(northeast)

command MOVE.EAST = MOVE(east)

command MOVE.SOUTHEAST = MOVE(southeast)

command MOVE.SOUTH = MOVE(south)

command MOVE.SOUTHWEST = MOVE(southwest)

command MOVE.WEST = MOVE(west)

command MOVE.NORTHWEST = MOVE(northwest)

command WAIT() cost 120:
    return

command SNEAK() cost 0:
    if actor has SNEAKING:
        remove(actor, SNEAKING)
    else:
        add(actor, SNEAKING())

command FIGHT(dir: dir) cost 120:
    others = entities(in: actor.at + dir) where it != actor and it has HP
    if others.count == 0:
        return false
    other = others.first
    if ALIGNMENT_OF(actor) >= GOOD_AT and not ENEMIES(actor, other):
        return false
    return ATTACK(other)

command FIGHT.NORTH = FIGHT(north)

command FIGHT.NORTHEAST = FIGHT(northeast)

command FIGHT.EAST = FIGHT(east)

command FIGHT.SOUTHEAST = FIGHT(southeast)

command FIGHT.SOUTH = FIGHT(south)

command FIGHT.SOUTHWEST = FIGHT(southwest)

command FIGHT.WEST = FIGHT(west)

command FIGHT.NORTHWEST = FIGHT(northwest)

command FEED(item: entity from actor.PACK.items where it has FOOD, target: pos aim 1 at entities(in: adjacent(actor)) where it has HP) cost 120:
    eaters = entities(in: target) where it != actor and it has HP
    if eaters.count == 0 or not target in adjacent(actor):
        return false
    BEFRIEND(eaters.first, actor, item.FOOD.points, group: item.FOOD.group)
    destroy(item)
```

engine.lib/std/relations.rlml:
# STD: Suhteet

> Koottu vakiokirjaston luvuista (STD 3 ja 7). Speksi on normatiivinen,
> joten muutos tehdään ensin speksiin.

namespace STD

component ALIGNMENT
- value number default 0

component FACTION
- group name

component BONDS
- toward dict entity number

component STANCE
- toward dict name number

component FACTIONS
- items collection

entity GROUP.PLAYER

constants
- TOLERANCE 50
- FRIENDLY 50
- PROVOKED -50
- GOOD_AT 34
- EVIL_AT -34
- KIN_RANGE 8

```roguescript
query GROUP_OF(e: entity) -> entity:
    if e has no FACTION or game has no FACTIONS:
        return none
    return (game.FACTIONS.items where it is e.FACTION.group).first

query GROUP_STANCE(a: entity, b: entity) -> number:
    ga = GROUP_OF(a)
    if ga == none or ga has no STANCE or b has no FACTION:
        return none
    if not b.FACTION.group in ga.STANCE.toward:
        return none
    return ga.STANCE.toward[b.FACTION.group]

query BASE(a: entity, b: entity) -> number:
    s = GROUP_STANCE(a, b)
    if s != none:
        return s
    d = 0
    if a has ALIGNMENT:
        d += a.ALIGNMENT.value
    if b has ALIGNMENT:
        d -= b.ALIGNMENT.value
    return TOLERANCE - max(d, -d)

query ATTITUDE(a: entity, b: entity) -> number:
    if a has BONDS and b in a.BONDS.toward:
        return a.BONDS.toward[b]
    return BASE(a, b)

fn BEFRIEND(a: entity, b: entity, points: number, group: bool = false):
    if group:
        ga = GROUP_OF(a)
        if ga != none and b has FACTION:
            if ga has no STANCE:
                add(ga, STANCE(toward: {}))
            ga.STANCE.toward[b.FACTION.group] = min(100, max(-100, BASE(a, b) + points))
            return
    if a has no BONDS:
        add(a, BONDS(toward: {}))
    a.BONDS.toward[b] = min(100, max(-100, ATTITUDE(a, b) + points))

query ALIGNMENT_OF(e: entity) -> number:
    if e has ALIGNMENT:
        return e.ALIGNMENT.value
    return 0

query ENEMIES(a: entity, b: entity) -> bool:
    return ATTITUDE(a, b) < 0 or ATTITUDE(b, a) < 0

query FRIENDS(a: entity, b: entity) -> bool:
    return ATTITUDE(a, b) >= FRIENDLY and ATTITUDE(b, a) >= FRIENDLY

query MAY_ATTACK(a: entity, b: entity) -> bool:
    if a == b or b has no HP:
        return false
    if ALIGNMENT_OF(a) <= EVIL_AT:
        return ATTITUDE(a, b) < FRIENDLY
    return ENEMIES(a, b)

query NEUTRAL(e: entity) -> bool:
    return ALIGNMENT_OF(e) > EVIL_AT and ALIGNMENT_OF(e) < GOOD_AT

fn GRUDGE(victim: entity, attacker: entity):
    if victim has no BONDS:
        add(victim, BONDS(toward: {}))
    victim.BONDS.toward[attacker] = min(ATTITUDE(victim, attacker), PROVOKED)

fn PROVOKE(victim: entity, attacker: entity):
    if attacker == none or attacker == victim:
        return
    if seat_of(victim) != none and seat_of(attacker) != none:
        return
    GRUDGE(victim, attacker)
    if not NEUTRAL(victim) or victim has no FACTION:
        return
    kin = entities(in: near(victim, KIN_RANGE)) where it != victim and it != attacker and it has FACTION and it.FACTION.group == victim.FACTION.group and NEUTRAL(it) and sees(it, victim)
    for k in kin:
        GRUDGE(k, attacker)

on HIT(target, attacker, amount) as PROVOKE_HIT priority 1:
    PROVOKE(target, attacker)

after MISSED(target, attacker) as PROVOKE_MISS:
    PROVOKE(target, attacker)
```
